name: 28223 · Charlotte, NC
findings: ZIP 28223 (Charlotte) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 28223 (Charlotte) has 23 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Where do people here come together, and who brings them together? Which of those places would not show up in nonprofit records?
